requirement: two independent human reviewers familiar with fixed-income data, not involved in setting thresholds, plus a third adjudicator; chosen by the owner and identified privately (not in this repository)

vignetteCheck.rule: each reviewer labels integrity and context independently, blind to the intended answers; disagreements recorded with reasons

pilot.draw: 25 items from roster-r9 by seeded random order, all tracks
pilot.rule: rubric changes after seeing pilot labels are versioned and affected items relabelled

gatePasses: vignette disagreements resolvable by the rubric itself, and pilot complete; only then may labels-r8.json receive labels
appliesTo: roster-r9.json (r9 is the current frozen version)
